evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating multiple LLMs reveals substantial robustness gaps: average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training.
